<script>
  // Set-wall parallax: every sleeve drifts at its own rate (--d) against
  // scroll. Desktop-map layouts only (>=1100px; the packed grids hold still),
  // reduced motion wins outright, and with JS off the walls are simply
  // static — placement never depends on this script.
  (function () {
    var mm = window.matchMedia;
    if (!mm || mm('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    var tiles = [];
    document.querySelectorAll('.cover-wall .wall-tile').forEach(function (t) {
      tiles.push({ el: t, d: parseFloat(t.style.getPropertyValue('--d')) || 0 });
    });
    if (!tiles.length) return;
    var MAX = 96, wide = mm('(min-width: 1100px)').matches, ticking = false;
    function frame() {
      ticking = false;
      var vh = window.innerHeight;
      var shifts = tiles.map(function (t) {
        var r = t.el.getBoundingClientRect();          // read phase
        if (r.bottom < -MAX || r.top > vh + MAX) return null;
        return ((r.top + r.height / 2 - vh / 2) / vh) * t.d * -MAX;
      });
      shifts.forEach(function (y, i) {                 // write phase
        if (y !== null) tiles[i].el.style.transform = 'translate3d(0,' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px,0)';
      });
    }
    function onScroll() {
      if (!wide || ticking) return;
      ticking = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    mm('(min-width: 1100px)').addEventListener('change', function (e) {
      wide = e.matches;
      if (!wide) tiles.forEach(function (t) { t.el.style.transform = ''; });
      else onScroll();
    });
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();
  })();
</script>

props.title: nobody wants to get the booking wrong

image.alt: Guests raising glasses in a toast at a dinner under string lights.

props.lede: Hiring the right entertainment can be nerve-racking. Everyone's got an opinion, and to some degree, your reputation might be on the line.

headingText.html: Signet Artists makes it hard to get wrong. You get an act that fits your vision, sound support that's the right size for the venue, and clear, professional support all along the way.

props.headingNote: Learn what live music costs in different markets including Colorado, the Front Range and Nationally.

image.alt: The Denver skyline against the Front Range, from City Park.

props.title: We'll put together the right music for your event.
props.lede: When you book a band on your own, there's a lot to work out with the musicians, and then you have to get them all into a contract. We'll work through them with you, and the same person will be your point of contact from your first email to the end of your event.

rows.text: A duo works beautifully at a dinner, a trio can get people dancing, and a full band has the energy for a big ballroom. We'll help you pick the right size based on your guest count, your budget and where the music fits in your event.
We can bring the sound up to reach the back of a ballroom or keep it low enough that guests can talk over dinner, and we'll work within any noise limit your venue sets.
You might want jazz during dinner, a soul band for dancing, a string quartet for a ceremony or a DJ to finish the party. Tell us about the crowd and we’ll recommend the act that suits it.
Let us know your must-plays, the songs you'd rather skip and your first dance, and we can keep the lyrics clean for a work crowd. We'll go over the song list with you before your event.
The musicians dress to your dress code, from black tie to business casual to all black, so they look like they belong at your event.
We can add a photographer or videographer who works alongside the band, so your event is captured without a second vendor to manage. Learn more about event photos and video.

props.html: All of it goes into one contract. If your venue asks for an insurance certificate, just let us know and we can send it over. Curious about the steps? Take a look at how a booking works.

props.title: we love helping bring magical events together
props.lede: Share the details and we can bring together the entertainment to fit your night perfectly.
